# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest stable release of FilaCheck receives security updates. Please
upgrade to the latest release before reporting a vulnerability.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in FilaCheck, please do not open a
public GitHub issue.

Report it privately by emailing
[povilas@laraveldaily.com](mailto:povilas@laraveldaily.com).

Please include enough detail to reproduce and assess the issue. Reports will be
treated confidentially and addressed as soon as possible.
